candidate_pass.frequency_axis: Output Hz; source Nyquist and native-stop events refer to complete source aliases
candidate_pass.near_zero_meaning: A closed interval starting at zero includes every positive rational or real frequency sufficiently near zero.
candidate_pass.scope: Exact set coverage only. A planned interval is not a PASS; only the candidate-pass selection uses certified intervals.
candidate_pass.transition_meaning: Both one-sided neighborhoods require selected intervals on both sides; a zero-width point is insufficient.
